description: AI chat request object. Requires id, messages, and trigger, plus at least one of chatTypeParam or chatTypeId to identify which chat type this conversation belongs to.

parts.description: Ordered content fragments produced by the AI SDK UIMessage format. The `type` field discriminates between text, step markers, and tool invocations (e.g. "tool-{toolName}").

type.description: Discriminator for the part kind. Well-known values are "text" and "step-start"; tool invocation parts use "tool-{toolName}".

toolCallId.description: Unique identifier for a tool invocation part.

input.description: Input arguments passed to the tool.

trigger.description: Indicates which user or system action caused this AI response to be generated. Implementations should use consistent, machine-readable identifiers (e.g. "submit-message").

chatTypeParam.description: A flexible chat type identifier extracted from the URL. Can be any of the three unique identifiers from the chat_types table: the UUID id, the seoFriendlyId slug, or the seoFriendlyBase64Id. The backend resolves this to the chat type UUID. At least one of chatTypeParam or chatTypeId must be provided.

chatTypeId.description: The direct UUID of the chat type. Used as a fallback when chatTypeParam is not provided. Must be a valid UUIDv7. At least one of chatTypeParam or chatTypeId must be provided.
